qa_pair.question: In the fixed October fixture, compare all active projects by outstanding leaf-task estimates. Which project has the largest remaining work? Return its title.
Find the overdue high-priority unfinished milestone in the fixed fixture, identify its project, and resolve the project's owner. Return that person's full name.
Inspect the recovery preview for the project with accepted history, confirm the preview's predecessor exists in that history, and return its recovery target in YYYY-MM-DD.
Using the immutable completion facts for October 20 through 26 in the fixed fixture, what percentage of dated task finishes were on time? Return an integer.
Find the late completion in the fixed October report, resolve its task, then identify the project that owns it. Return the project title.
For the project that has an accepted weekly plan, total the remaining estimated minutes of unfinished leaf tasks assigned to its owner, excluding teammates' work. Return an integer.
Compare the original accepted plan's sessions with its immutable task snapshot. How many minutes were reserved for the completed inspiration task? Return an integer.
Across all projects in the fixed fixture, how many remaining estimated minutes belong to high-priority unfinished leaf tasks assigned to Alex Morgan? Return an integer.
Compare the dated completion facts' start and finish instants for October 20 through 26. What is the median execution cycle in minutes? Return an integer.
Inspect the project containing the fundamentals practice task, its membership and task list. Is that project private and limited to the task's assignee? Return True or False.
